user.title: Biamp Tesira
user.description: Enter the Tesira's control-network address. It speaks the Tesira Text Protocol on TCP port 23 with no authentication.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tesira over TTP. Check the IP and that port 23 is open.

init.title: DSP design
init.description: A JSON list of the DSP blocks to expose, each `{"tag": "instanceTag", "kind": "kind", ...}`. Kinds: aecinput, input, meter, level, mute (all take `channels`); standardmixer, matrixmixer (take `inputs` and `outputs`). Find instance tags in Tesira software (right-click a block, then Properties). Leave the shipped example if you just want to try it. {error_detail}
